استحرمن (form X)
# اِسْتَحْرَمْنَ (istaḥramna) /is.taħ.ram.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# اُسْتُحْرِمْنَ (ustuḥrimna) /us.tuħ.rim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# اِسْتَحْرِمْنَ (istaḥrimna) /is.taħ.rim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
